snakefile.content:
# TENET analysis workflow

# Input data
INPUT_H5AD = "user/testuser/data/pbmc_light_1000.h5ad"
GENE_LIST = "user/testuser/data/unique_genes.txt"
TF_LIST = "user/testuser/data/GO_symbol_human_regulation_of_transcription+sequence-specific_DNA_binding_list.txt"

# Output directory
RESULTS_DIR = "user/testuser/workflow_1/algorithm_16/results"
LOGS_DIR = "user/testuser/workflow_1/algorithm_16/logs"

# Parameters
FDR_THRESHOLD = 0.01
NUM_OUTDEGREES = 1000
TRIMMING_THRESHOLD = 0
NUM_DEVICES = 4
UMAP_LASSO = "seurat_annotation"
CELL_GROUP = "CD4+ T;Memory CD4+ T;B;CD14+ Mono"
PSEUDOTIME = "Pseudotime"

rule all:
    input:
        f"{RESULTS_DIR}/FdrOutdegree.txt",
        f"{RESULTS_DIR}/NumlinksOutdegree.txt",
        f"{RESULTS_DIR}/FdrTrimOutdegree.txt",
        f"{RESULTS_DIR}/NumlinksTrimOutdegree.txt"

rule TENET_Input:
    input:
        h5ad=INPUT_H5AD,
        genes=GENE_LIST
    output:
        expression=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/expression.csv",
        trajectory=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/trajectory.txt",
        cells=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/cellSelect.txt"
    log:
        stdout=f"{LOGS_DIR}/TENET_Input.stdout",
        stderr=f"{LOGS_DIR}/TENET_Input.stderr"
    shell:
        "/opt/micromamba/envs/plugin_env/bin/python /scripts/tenet_input.py "
        "{input.h5ad} {input.genes} {UMAP_LASSO} {output.expression} "
        "{output.trajectory} {output.cells} {UMAP_LASSO} {PSEUDOTIME} "
        "'{CELL_GROUP}' > {log.stdout} 2> {log.stderr}"

rule Run:
    input:
        expression=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/expression.csv",
        trajectory=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/trajectory.txt",
        cells=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/cellSelect.txt",
        tf_list=TF_LIST
    output:
        result=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/resultMatrix.txt"
    log:
        stdout=f"{LOGS_DIR}/Run.stdout",
        stderr=f"{LOGS_DIR}/Run.stderr"
    shell:
        "/opt/micromamba/envs/plugin_env/bin/python /scripts/tenet_for_cellcraft.py "
        "{input.expression} {input.trajectory} {input.cells} {input.tf_list} "
        "{output.result} {NUM_DEVICES} > {log.stdout} 2> {log.stderr}"

rule GRN_Reconstruction__FDR:
    input:
        result=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/resultMatrix.txt"
    output:
        network=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/Fdr.sif"
    log:
        stdout=f"{LOGS_DIR}/GRN_Reconstruction__FDR.stdout",
        stderr=f"{LOGS_DIR}/GRN_Reconstruction__FDR.stderr"
    shell:
        "/opt/micromamba/envs/plugin_env/bin/python /scripts/makeGRN.py "
        "{input.result} {output.network} {FDR_THRESHOLD} > {log.stdout} 2> {log.stderr}"

rule GRN_Reconstruction__NumLinks:
    input:
        result=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/resultMatrix.txt"
    output:
        network=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/Numlinks.sif"
    log:
        stdout=f"{LOGS_DIR}/GRN_Reconstruction__NumLinks.stdout",
        stderr=f"{LOGS_DIR}/GRN_Reconstruction__NumLinks.stderr"
    shell:
        "/opt/micromamba/envs/plugin_env/bin/python /scripts/makeGRNsameNumberOfLinks.py "
        "{input.result} {output.network} {NUM_OUTDEGREES} > {log.stdout} 2> {log.stderr}"

rule Indirect_Edge_Trimming:
    input:
        fdr=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/Fdr.sif",
        numlinks=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/Numlinks.sif"
    output:
        fdr_trim=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/FdrTrim.sif",
        numlinks_trim=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/NumlinksTrim.sif"
    log:
        stdout=f"{LOGS_DIR}/Indirect_Edge_Trimming.stdout",
        stderr=f"{LOGS_DIR}/Indirect_Edge_Trimming.stderr"
    shell:
        "/opt/micromamba/envs/plugin_env/bin/python /scripts/trim_indirect.py "
        "{input.fdr} {input.numlinks} {output.fdr_trim} {output.numlinks_trim} "
        "{TRIMMING_THRESHOLD} > {log.stdout} 2> {log.stderr}"

rule Counting_Outdegree:
    input:
        fdr=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/Fdr.sif",
        numlinks=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/Numlinks.sif",
        fdr_trim=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/FdrTrim.sif",
        numlinks_trim=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/NumlinksTrim.sif"
    output:
        fdr_out=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/FdrOutdegree.txt",
        numlinks_out=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/NumlinksOutdegree.txt",
        fdr_trim_out=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/FdrTrimOutdegree.txt",
        numlinks_trim_out=f"{RESULTS_DIR}/NumlinksTrimOutdegree.txt"
    log:
        stdout=f"{LOGS_DIR}/Counting_Outdegree.stdout",
        stderr=f"{LOGS_DIR}/Counting_Outdegree.stderr"
    shell:
        "/opt/micromamba/envs/plugin_env/bin/python /scripts/countOutdegree.py "
        "{input.fdr} {input.numlinks} {input.fdr_trim} {input.numlinks_trim} "
        "{output.fdr_out} {output.numlinks_out} {output.fdr_trim_out} "
        "{output.numlinks_trim_out} > {log.stdout} 2> {log.stderr}"
